Same-Day Taj Mahal Tour from Delhi

A full, stress-free Taj Mahal day trip starting directly from your Delhi hotel or Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) with a private AC car or express train.

Duration

10 to 12 Hours

Pickup at 06:00 AM (or early 02:30 AM for sunrise option).

Delhi to Agra Itinerary Overview

  • 06:00 AM: Door-to-door pickup from your Delhi, Gurgaon, or Noida hotel/airport in a sanitized, air-conditioned sedan or SUV.
  • 09:15 AM: Smooth arrival in Agra via the 6-lane Yamuna Expressway. Meet your dedicated local storyteller guide.
  • 09:30 AM – 12:00 PM: Comprehensive Taj Mahal tour with architectural insights and iconic photo assistance.
  • 12:30 PM – 01:30 PM: Lunch break at a curated 5-star hotel buffet or authentic local Mughlai restaurant.
  • 01:45 PM – 03:15 PM: Visit the UNESCO World Heritage Agra Fort.
  • 03:30 PM: Relaxing journey back to Delhi, arriving comfortably by 06:30 PM – 07:00 PM.
